candidates.name: Phaser 3.90.0

webLite.evidence: The repository already pins Phaser 3.90.0 and uses its Canvas/WebGL browser runtime for web-lite development evidence.

wechatMiniGame.evidence: Phaser is browser-oriented and this research found no maintained, validated Phaser 3 adapter for the DOM-less WeChat Mini Game runtime.

douyinMiniGame.evidence: No official open-source Phaser 3 adapter with immutable revision and direct license evidence was found for Douyin Mini Game.

tapTapMiniGame.evidence: No official open-source Phaser 3 adapter with immutable revision and direct license evidence was found for TapTap Mini Game.

attributionDuties: Retain the Phaser MIT copyright and permission notice in distributed copies or substantial portions.
approvedScope: Existing pinned Phaser 3.90.0 dependency for isolated web-lite greybox rendering and browser QA only.
candidates.rationale: The v3.90.0 release is pinned to immutable commit a9965625f49cf366584f454556b039e06e8adad6. It is not approval or evidence for any mini-game platform package.

candidates.name: Microsoft Playwright 1.62.1

webLite.evidence: Playwright drives the independent Chromium QA runner and records screenshots, logs, and traces.

wechatMiniGame.evidence: Browser automation does not build or prove a WeChat Mini Game package.

douyinMiniGame.evidence: Browser automation does not build or prove a Douyin Mini Game package.

tapTapMiniGame.evidence: Browser automation does not build or prove a TapTap Mini Game package.

attributionDuties: Preserve the Apache-2.0 license and applicable copyright, patent, trademark, attribution, and NOTICE obligations when redistributing the work.
approvedScope: Development-only deterministic web-lite QA; never platform packaging evidence.
candidates.rationale: The v1.62.1 release is pinned to immutable commit 26a9e470a7b3c7822084b09fb7f13902c5f37b51 and remains outside shipped game code.

candidates.name: WeChat minigame-adaptor

webLite.evidence: The adapter is unrelated to browser QA.

wechatMiniGame.evidence: The official repository is archived and its documented workflow targets Unity asset migration rather than the current Phaser 3 TypeScript runtime.

douyinMiniGame.evidence: The repository targets WeChat and provides no Douyin adapter.

tapTapMiniGame.evidence: The repository targets WeChat and provides no TapTap adapter.

attributionDuties: If ever reconsidered, retain BSD-3-Clause notices and comply with the listed Apache-2.0 third-party component duties.
candidates.rationale: Archived status, Unity-specific scope, and lack of Phaser 3 fit make reuse riskier than a project-owned platform adapter.

conclusion.architectureDecision: Continue the A/B/C action experiment only as isolated web-lite development and QA evidence. Add no dependency and make no WeChat, Douyin, or TapTap publishability claim; each platform adapter remains a separate research, build, and device-QA stage.
